answer: Mirror-Raven Coordination Tariff: agents submit signed action vectors each epoch. The protocol estimates pairwise mutual information over timing/targets, builds a mirror graph of synchronized clusters, and charges each cluster a tariff equal to KL divergence from the product of marginals; an ivory baseline (median divergence) sets zero. A Sybil farm pays recurring tariffs for shared timing; splitting identities hides coordination only by losing exploit precision. A raven flag marks outlier clusters for audit.
